headline: A 2022 House bill would have named a Petaluma, California post office after former Representative Lynn C. Woolsey, but it was voted down.
what_it_does: The bill would have renamed the U.S. Postal Service facility at 120 4th Street in Petaluma, California, as the "Lynn C. Woolsey Post Office Building." It was a naming measure only and would not have changed postal services, mail delivery, or building operations. The House rejected it on February 9, 2022, so it did not become law.
